sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of mitapivat during breastfeeding. Because mitapivat is more than 97% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If a mother requires mitapivat, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Until more data are available, mitapivat should only be used with careful infant monitoring for jaundice during breastfeeding.
